propositions: Rehearse multi-project bridge scenarios against a real ephemeral Jira DC instance instead of live Cloud to enable creation/teardown of throwaway projects and avoid cross-project contamination.

Non-existent project keys in configured mappings must fail closed (parse error, abort pass) rather than return empty, and this fail-closed behavior cannot be validated against a stateful fake transport.
Each mutating scenario must be preview-gated with dry-run first to assert the planned mutation set targets only the intended project before sync executes, preventing cross-project leakage.

Scratch projects must be provisioned with verified capabilities (issue types/fields) and torn down on every exit path including mid-run failures, with session guards preventing leaked projects from prior runs.
The test must validate that configured-but-unmapped projects behave fail-closed (search raises, pass writes nothing) and that empty real projects return no issues without error.
